title: Developer change control and security and privacy review need exact change evidence
remediation: The sponsor change authority and developer configuration lead agree control scope across approved lifecycle stages and designate security and privacy reviewers and flaw-report recipients. Trace a representative change using the protected baseline, approval, impact assessment, changed configuration, and evidence that unauthorized changes are refused. Record a tracked flaw through resolution and reporting.

milestones.title: Collect change-control scope and named reviewers, an approved change and impact trace, and the linked flaw and reporting records
